name: fullstack-vite-express-starter
description: Founding.dev fullstack starter — React + Vite + Express + Prisma/Postgres (Mongo opt-in) + Docker Compose.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run test:watch -w server" "npm run test:watch -w client"
